label: PROPER_PART_EXTENSIONALITY_2: composite-restricted strict-part identity
definition: For any two composite objects x and y, SameProperParts x y implies x=y. Both compared objects must have a strict part; their individual parts are not restricted. Strong supplementation entails this principle. It places no identity constraint on two minimal objects.
